answer: Rotation is written down in the basalt index and the pigment audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 258 keys live and online for the whole period, which means the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the nectar beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
